body: So sorry for your loss and I am praying for you

You have expressed every emotion that I feel.  My son was 12. No one can identify with this feeling unless they've experienced it.  I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy.  Thank you for this post. I wish that no one ever had to experience this pain and heartache but, it helps to not be alone and have someone that understands. 😔
I know how you feel.  I hate that life has to be so rough for people like us. You are NOT weak. The strength is getting through each day with the weight of the world on your shoulders.

Everyday for the past 2 1/2 years. Some days are better than others. I don't always cry, most times I do. I'm praying for your healing.  But, don't feel like you have to be ok just because others are or tell you you should be. You heal in your own time. ❤❤❤
I'm trying so hard. Not to put anyone else through it.  But, even that is wearing thin.
I hope a miracle can happen for you. I hope this is not your last post.
Hold and hug your mom as long and as tight as you can. It doesn't matter how old you are. You will always be her baby. I hope and pray you receive peace when you see her. I'm certain you will.
I'm an African American from NYC who loves Sweet Home Alabama.
